verses.text: ajaabanii khayru baaqin fiihi qad taabaa
kullii wa raqqaa bimaa lii qaada aqtaabaa
liwajhi baaqin mahaa qasdal mabiihi lanaa
faaraqtuhu wahwa laj wal amlu maa khaabaa
bihtul lazii laysa yanhuunii wa lii badalii
wa lii yukhalliduhu man kabba sakhkhaabaa
ilaa siwaayal hidaa tanhuu bimaa mahahum
wa bii yusaffii ilaahid dahra albaabaa
quluubu man lam yahibbuunii halaa wajalin
yanqaadu lii kullu maaraamal kiraamu munan
wal laahu raqqaa bimaa lii qaada aqtaabaa
